plan_item: 77.44.7.A — responsive visibility Inspector / Canvas / Save / Publish lifecycle
finding: The earlier layer-visibility browser regression asserted draft state and Save-versus-Publish state, but did not load the published route and assert the actual public renderer at both mobile and desktop viewports.
change: Extended tests/browser/editor-element-insertion.test.js with public renderer assertions. No runtime source or public asset changed.
coverage: A published section initially renders on mobile (390px) and desktop (1366px).
Changing mobile visibility updates the Canvas and draft; Save persists the draft without changing the public snapshot or visible public pages.
Explicit Publish removes the hidden section from the mobile public DOM while preserving desktop visibility.
Showing the mobile section and saving leaves the public mobile page hidden; a separate Publish restores the section in the public renderer.
